simple.meaning: חָתַף (châthaph) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to clutch.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Job, beginning at Job 9:12. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָתַף (H2862) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: חָתַף (châthaph) / H2862 is traced through Job 9:12 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H2862. chathaph [ חָתַף ] verb seize, snatch away (compare Aramaic Pa`el break in, pieces ; Arabic death ) — Qal Imperfect no object expressed יְשִׁיבֶנּוּ וּמִי יַחְתֹּף הֵן Job 9:12 lo ! he seizeth, and who shall turn him back ?
